blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite decades of progress, image codecs remain difficult to adapt to diverse real-world compression scenarios for two main reasons. First, most image codecs are optimized for a specific objective and require substantial redevelopment when the compression goal changes. Second, they typically assume clean inputs, whereas sensor-captured images often contain degradations that alter rate-quality behavior. To address these challenges, we propose Practical Image Coding Agents (PICA), a multi-agent framework that adapts existing codecs to diverse user requirements and potentially degraded inputs. PICA consists of four collaborative agents: a Perception agent that interprets user intent and analyzes image content, an Improvement agent that jointly considers bitrate and reconstruction quality to guide pre-coding restoration, a Coding agent that refines quality-control settings from global to regional levels, and an After-coding improvement agent that addresses residual degradations and compression-induced artifacts through restoration guided solely by image quality. To enable codec-agnostic regional adaptation, we introduce Agentic ROI Coding (AROIC), which treats the codec as a black box and allows the agent to automatically schedule, execute, evaluate, and reflect ROI coding plans without architectural modifications or codec-specific retraining. We integrate these four agents with a Scenario-Guided Quality-Rate (SGQR) evaluation strategy to enable more effective scenario-adaptive compression across heterogeneous codecs. Comprehensive experiments on clean, noisy, and blurred images across standard, perceptual, and machine-vision compression scenarios demonstrate that PICA consistently enhances the compression performance of both the conventional H.266/VVC codec and the neural Cheng2020 codec, outperforming competing compression methods on the Kodak, CLIC2020, and HEVC datasets.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了几十年的进步,图像解码器仍然难以适应多种多样的现实世界压缩情景,主要原因有二. 首先,大多数图像解码器都是为特定的目标进行优化,在压缩目标改变时需要进行实质性的再开发. 其次,它们通常假定是干净的输入,而传感器捕获的图像往往含有可改变速率质量行为的退化。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用实用图像编码代理(PICA)这一多代理框架,使现有的编码器适应不同的用户要求和可能退化的投入。 PICA由四个协作剂组成:一个解释用户意图和分析图像内容的感知剂,一个共同考虑比特率和重建质量以指导编码前恢复的改进剂,一个完善从全球到区域各级质量控制设置的编码剂,以及一个通过完全以图像质量为指导的恢复来解决残余降解和压缩引起的文物的编码后改进剂. 为了实现代码不可知的区域适应,我们引入了Agentic ROI Coding(AROIC),它把代码作为黑匣子处理,并且允许代理在不进行建筑修改或特定代码再培训的情况下,自动安排,执行,评价和反映ROI编码计划. 我们把这4种药剂与“设想”-指导质量-Rate(SGQR)评价战略结合起来,以便更有效地对各种编码器进行情景调整压缩。 有关清洁、吵闹和模糊的图像的全面实验,跨越标准、感知和机器视觉压缩情景,表明PICA一贯加强传统的H.266/VVC编码器和神经程2020编码器的压缩性能,在Kodak、CLIC2020和HEVC数据集上的表现超过了相互竞争的压缩方法。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Image compression is a fundamental problem in signal processing, as the rapidly growing volume and resolution of visual data impose substantial costs on storage, transmission bandwidth, and communication latency. This has been extensively studied for more than three decades, leading to mature hand-engineered image coding standards such as JPEG [ 1 ] . Such traditional codecs remain widely used in practical image storage and communication systems. More recent standards, such as H.266/VVC [ 2 ] , also support high-efficiency image compression through intra-frame coding. With rapid advances in deep learning, neural image compression (NIC) methods have achieved substantial progress by jointly optimizing nonlinear transforms and entropy models under end-to-end rate–distortion (RD) objectives [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . Representative methods such as Cheng2020 [ 11 ] have demonstrated RD performance competitive with or superior to those traditional codecs on the standard compression benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 图像压缩是信号处理中的一个基本问题,因为视觉数据数量和分辨率的迅速增长给存储,传输带宽和通信延迟带来了巨大的成本. 这已经被广泛研究了30多年,导致JPEG[1]等成熟的手动图像编码标准. 这种传统的编码器仍然广泛用于实际的图像存储和通信系统. H266/VVC[2]等较近期的标准也支持通过帧内编码实现高效图像压缩. 随着深度学习的迅速进步,神经图像压缩(NIC)方法通过在端对端速率(RD)目标[3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10]下共同优化非线性变换和演算模型,取得了实质性进展. Cheng2020[11]等代表性方法在标准压缩基准上显示RD性能与这些传统编码器具有竞争力或优于这些编码器.

blocks.en: Despite this tremendous success, most widely deployed codecs are designed primarily for generic pixel-fidelity reconstruction, with their RD performance conventionally optimized and evaluated using distortion metrics such as PSNR, a compression scenario referred to as standard compression . However, modern visual-data ecosystems increasingly involve heterogeneous consumers and objectives with distinct compression intents. For example, some compressed images are primarily expected to preserve visual realism and semantic fidelity for human observers [ 12 , 13 , 7 , 14 ] , a compression scenario referred to as perceptual compression . Meanwhile, an increasing proportion of visual data is consumed by downstream machine-learning systems, where compression should preserve task-relevant information and downstream accuracy [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] , a compression scenario referred to as machine-vision compression . Unfortunately, prior studies [ 7 , 14 , 16 , 17 ] have shown that commonly used standard codecs can become suboptimal in these specialized compression scenarios.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这一巨大成功,但最广泛部署的编码器主要是为通用像素-忠诚重建而设计的,其RD性能通常通过PSNR等扭曲度度量度来优化和评价,这种压缩方案被称为标准压缩. 然而,现代视觉数据生态系统越来越多地涉及具有明显压缩意图的不同消费者和目标。 例如,一些压缩图像主要期望为人类观察者保留视觉现实主义和语义上的忠诚[12,13,7,14],这种压缩情景被称为知觉压缩. 与此同时,越来越多的视觉数据被下游机器学习系统所消耗,其中压缩应当保存与任务相关的信息和下游准确性[15,16,17],这种压缩情景被称为机器视觉压缩. 不幸的是,先前的研究[7,14,16,17]已经表明,常用的标准编码器在这些专门的压缩情景中可能会成为次优.

blocks.en: Developing dedicated codecs for these specialized scenarios provides an intuitive solution. With the flexibility of NIC, several scenario-specific methods have therefore been proposed. For example, machine-vision compression approaches [ 16 , 17 ] introduce task-aware compression modules to produce latent representations that preserve information relevant to downstream vision tasks. Meanwhile, perceptual NIC methods [ 13 , 7 ] combine powerful generative models with human-perception-oriented objectives, such as LPIPS [ 18 ] , to reconstruct visually plausible content. Though these specialized designs achieve substantial improvements in their respective scenarios, they are typically tightly coupled with extensive scenario-specific modules and objectives, thereby requiring considerable architectural redesign and substantial re-optimization when the compression intent changes. Consequently, they exhibit limited generalizability across diverse compression scenarios. This limitation motivates our first research question (RQ): RQ1: Can existing widely-used codecs be rapidly adapted to diverse compression scenarios without architectural redesign or substantial re-optimization?
blocks.zh: 为这些特殊情景开发专门的解码器提供了一个直观的解决方案. 因此,由于国家执行措施的灵活性,提出了几种针对具体情景的方法。 例如,机视压缩方法[16,17]引入了任务感压缩模块,以产生潜在的表达,保存与下游视觉任务相关的信息. 同时,感知性NIC方法[13,7]结合了强大的基因模型和人类认知导向的目标,如LPIPS[18],重建视觉上可信的内容. 尽管这些专门设计在其各自的情景中取得了实质性的改进,但它们通常与广泛的情景特定模块和目标紧密结合,因此需要在压缩意图发生变化时对建筑进行大量的重新设计和大幅度的再优化。 因此,它们在不同压缩情况下的通用性有限。 这一限制激发了我们的第一个研究问题(RQ):RQ1:现有的广泛使用的解码器能否在不进行建筑重新设计或实质性再优化的情况下,迅速适应不同的压缩情景?

blocks.en:
Beyond their limited generalizability across compression scenarios, most existing codecs are developed under the assumption of clean input images. In practice, however, acquired images may exhibit degradations ( e.g. , noise) due to limitations of imaging sensors, such as those in smartphone cameras. These degradations not only compromise visual quality but also introduce undesirable signal variations that may increase the number of bits required for compression [ 19 , 20 ] .
To address this issue, recent studies have jointly optimized restoration and compression or introduced restoration-aware compression modules [ 19 , 21 , 20 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] . However, these approaches still rely on dedicated components and degradation-specific optimization. Moreover, they generally assume that the degradation type and restoration objective are known in advance, rather than autonomously determining whether restoration is necessary and how it should be coordinated before and after coding. It motivates our second RQ: RQ2: Can an existing widely used codec autonomously detect image degradations and adaptively coordinate pre-coding and post-coding restoration without substantial re-development?
blocks.zh:
除了在各种压缩情景中有限的通用性外,大多数现有的编码器都是在清洁输入图像的假设下开发的. 然而,在实践中,由于像智能手机摄像机那样的成像传感器的局限性,获得的图像可能会出现退化(例如噪音)。 这些降解不仅会损害视觉质量,还会带来不良信号变异,可能增加压缩所需的位数[19,20].
为了解决这一问题,最近的研究联合优化了修复和压缩或引入了恢复意识压缩模块[19,21,20,22,23,24,25]. 然而,这些方法仍然依赖专门的组成部分和针对退化的优化。 此外,它们一般认为退化类型和恢复目标事先已经知道,而不是自主地确定恢复是否必要以及如何在编码之前和之后加以协调。 它激发了我们的第二个RQ: RQ2: 一个被广泛使用的编码器能够自主地检测图像退化,并适应性地协调编码前和编码后恢复,而不进行实质性的再开发吗?

blocks.en: To simultaneously address above two RQs, we propose Practical Image Coding Agents (PICA) , a multi-agent framework that adapts existing image codecs to diverse degraded inputs and compression scenarios through online and goal-oriented optimization. PICA consists of four collaborative agents: a P erception Agent, an I mprovement Agent, a C oding Agent, and an A fter-Coding Improvement Agent. Specifically, the Perception Agent interprets the user-specified compression intent while analyzing the input image, including its visual content, quality condition, and regions of interest, thereby providing structured guidance for subsequent agents.
blocks.zh: 为了同时处理以上两个RQ,我们提议实用图像编码代理(PICA),这是一个多代理框架,通过在线和面向目标的优化,使现有的图像编码器适应各种退化输入和压缩方案。 PICA由四个协作代理组成:一个P受体代理,一个I改进代理,一个CODing代理,以及一个Fter-Coding改进代理. 具体来说,Perception Agent在分析输入图像时解释用户指定的压缩意图,包括其视觉内容,质量条件,以及感兴趣的区域,从而为后续的代理提供结构化的指导.

blocks.en:
To address RQ1 , we introduce a Coding Agent with a global-to-regional coding quality refinement scheme.
Guided by the compression intent summarized by the Perception Agent, it first performs Global Quality Control (QC) Search, applying estimated QC to the target codec and iteratively refining them based on the measured bitrate and reconstruction quality until the user-specified requirements are satisfied.
Starting from this feasible global operating point, we further refine the coding quality of individual regions, motivated by prior studies showing that different compression scenarios assign different importance to image regions. For example, machine-vision compression often requires stronger preservation of task-relevant objects than background regions [ 17 , 16 ] . However, most existing methods [ 26 ] rely on codec-specific ROI coding mechanisms, requiring the underlying codec to be explicitly designed or trained with dedicated ROI functionality and thus limiting their generalizability to heterogeneous codecs without native ROI support.
blocks.zh:
为了解决RQ1问题,我们引入了一个编码代理,并有一个全球到区域编码质量改进计划。
在Perception Agent总结的压缩意图的指导下,它首先进行全球质量控制(QC)搜索,将估计的QC应用到目标编码器上,并根据测量的比特率和重建质量进行反复改进,直到满足用户指定的要求.
从这个可行的全球操作点开始,我们进一步完善了各个区域的编码质量,其动机是先前的研究显示,不同的压缩情景对图像区域具有不同的重要性. 例如,机器-视觉压缩往往比背景区域更需要保存与任务相关的物体[17,16]. 然而,大多数现有方法[26]都依赖于编码器特定ROI编码机制,要求基础编码器被明确设计或培训,具有专门的ROI功能,从而将其通用性限制在没有本地ROI支持的多种编码器上.

blocks.en: To overcome this limitation, we introduce Agentic ROI Coding (AROIC), which treats the underlying codec as a black box and follows a scheduling–execution–reflection loop. Specifically, the agent schedules and executes candidate coding plans that adjust the QC settings of the ROIs and background and, when beneficial, apply background downsampling. Each region is independently encoded using the target codec with its assigned QC setting, and the decoded regions are assembled into a complete reconstruction. The agent then evaluates the compression results and uses the evaluation feedback to refine subsequent coding plans while retaining the best-performing candidate. By relying on the codec’s native QC interface, AROIC enables ROI-aware adaptation across heterogeneous codecs without codec-specific redesign or retraining.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这一限制,我们引入了Agentic ROI Coding(AROIC),它把基本的代码当作一个黑匣子,并遵循一个排程-执行-反射循环. 具体地说,代理计划会安排和执行对ROI和背景的QC设置进行调整的候选编码计划,并在有利的情况下进行背景下取样. 每个区域都使用指定QC设置的目标编码器独立编码,解码区域被组装成完整的重建. 代理人然后评价压缩结果,并利用评价反馈来完善后续的编码计划,同时保留表现最佳的候选人. ARIOIC依靠编解码器的原生QC接口,可以使ROI-感知到各种编解码器的适应,而不进行具体编解码器的重新设计或再培训。

blocks.en:
Moreover, to address RQ2 , we introduce the Improvement Agent and the After-Coding Improvement Agent.
First, the Improvement Agent performs quality–rate (QR)-aware pre-coding restoration to mitigate input degradations and improve the overall QR trade-off. Unlike existing restoration agents [ 27 , 28 ] , which focus on correcting all detected degradations, our agent jointly evaluates the coding rate and reconstruction quality resulting from each candidate restoration operation. It retains only operations that improve the QR trade-off under the specified compression objective.
Similarly, the After-Coding Improvement Agent performs quality-aware post-coding restoration to mitigate residual degradations and potential compression-induced artifacts in the decoded image. This stage focuses on degradations that primarily affect reconstruction quality and adaptively applies restoration only when it improves the quality of the final decoded image.
blocks.zh:
此外,为了解决RQ2问题,我们引入了改进代理和后编码改进代理.
首先,改进代理公司进行质量-速率(QR)预知编码修复,以减少输入退化,改善总体的QR权衡. 现有的修复剂[27,28],其重点是纠正所有检测到的退化,与此不同的是,我们的毒剂联合评估了每次候选修复行动产生的编码率和重建质量. 它只保留在特定压缩目标下改进QR权衡的操作.
同样,编码后改进剂进行有质量意识的编码后恢复,以减轻解码图像中的残余退化和潜在的压缩引起的文物. 这一阶段的重点是主要影响重建质量的退化,只有在改善最终解码图像质量时才适应性地进行恢复.

blocks.en:
To align the collaborative agents with the intended compression scenario, we introduce a Scenario-Guided Quality–Rate (SGQR) evaluation strategy for the Improvement and Coding Agents. Specifically, SGQR evaluates each candidate improvement or coding plan using the bitrate and reconstructed image obtained after compression. It assesses reconstruction quality using scenario-specific metrics and selects the plan that offers the best QR trade-off under the user’s compression requirements.
Overall, our PICA integrates four collaborative agents with SGQR evaluation to adapt heterogeneous existing codecs to diverse compression scenarios without codec-specific redevelopment. We conduct extensive experiments on clean, noisy, and blurred images across standard, perceptual, and machine-vision compression scenarios. Results on the Kodak [ 29 ] , CLIC2020 [ 30 ] , and HEVC [ 31 ] datasets demonstrate that PICA consistently improves the compression performance of both H.266/VVC [ 2 ] and Cheng2020 [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh:
为了使协作代理人与预期的压缩情景保持一致,我们引入了改进和编码代理人的 " 设想 " 指导质量 -- -- 比例评价战略。 具体来说,SGQR利用压缩后获得的比特率和重建图像来评价每个候选的改进或编码计划. 它使用特定情景的衡量标准评估重建质量,并选择在用户压缩要求下提供最佳QR权衡的计划.
总体而言,我们的PICA将4个协作代理与SGQR评价整合在一起,以适应不同的现有编码器,适应不同的压缩假想,而无需代码特定的再开发. 我们进行广泛的实验, 研究干净,吵闹,模糊的图像, 跨越标准,视觉, 和机器视觉压缩的情景。 Kodak [29],CLIC2020 [30],HEVC [31]数据集的结果显示,PICA持续改善H266/VVC[2]和成2020[32]的压缩性能.

blocks.en: Our main contributions can be summarized as follows: • Practical Image Coding Agents. We propose a multi-agent framework that adapts existing image codecs to diverse compression scenarios and potentially degraded inputs through SGQR-guided optimization. • Quality–Rate–Aware Improvement Agents. We introduce a pre-coding improvement agent that jointly considers bitrate and reconstruction quality to address input degradations, and a post-coding improvement agent to mitigate residual and compression-induced degradations. • Codec–Agnostic Coding Agent. We introduce a Coding Agent with global-to-regional coding quality refinement together with AROIC, which treats the underlying codec as a black box and enables ROI-aware adaptation across heterogeneous codecs without codec-specific redesign.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献可归纳如下: • 实用图像编码代理。 我们提出了一个多剂框架,通过SGQR制导优化,使现有的图像编码器适应不同的压缩情景和潜在的退化输入. • 质量-定期-智能改进代理。 我们采用了一种编码前改进剂,联合考虑比特率和重建质量以解决输入降解问题,并采用了一种编码后改进剂,以减少残余和压缩引起的降解。 • 编码-不可知编码代理。 我们引入了一个编码代理,与AROIC一起改进了全球到区域编码质量,将基本编码视为一个黑匣子,并使得ROI-感知到不同编码器的适应,而无需对编码器进行具体的重新设计。

blocks.en: II Related Works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工程

blocks.en: II-A Image Compression
blocks.zh: II- A 图像压缩

blocks.en: Image compression methods broadly fall into conventional codecs and NIC. Conventional standards include JPEG [ 1 ] , JPEG2000 [ 33 ] , and intra-frame coding mode in H.265/HEVC [ 31 ] and H.266/VVC [ 2 ] . These standard codecs underpin practical compression systems. Driven by expressive neural architectures and end-to-end optimization, NIC has advanced substantially through hyperpriors [ 4 ] , autoregressive context models [ 5 ] , and Gaussian mixture entropy models with attention [ 11 ] , the latter achieving PSNR performance competitive with those standard codecs.
blocks.zh: 图像压缩方法大致属于常规编码器和NIC. 常规标准包括JPEG [1],JPEG 2000 [33],以及H.265/HEVC [31]和H.266/VVC [2]中的机体内编码模式. 这些标准编码器支撑着实用的压缩系统. 在表达神经架构和端到端优化的推动下,NIC通过超前导[4],自递性上下文模型[5],以及关注的高斯混合式 en模型[11],后者实现了PSNR性能与这些标准解码器的竞争.

blocks.en:
Beyond conventional compression that prioritizes pixel-wise reconstruction fidelity, growing attention has been devoted to alternative compression objectives. In this work, we focus on two challenging scenarios: perceptual compression [ 12 , 13 , 7 , 14 ] and machine-vision compression [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] .
Existing approaches address these objectives through specialized training strategies and architectural components. For example, HiFiC [ 7 ] combines adversarial training and perceptual optimizations to produce visually realistic reconstructions. Adapt-ICMH [ 17 ] optimizes a spatial-frequency modulation adapters to suppress task-irrelevant redundancy. Although effective for the specific scenarios, these approaches require objective-specific training or additional trainable components. In contrast, PICA is a training-free framework that adapts existing black-box codecs at inference time without codec re-optimization or scenario-specific module redesign. Through global-to-regional quality control, it allocates bits according to perceptual or task-specific priorities.
blocks.zh:
除了将像素至上重建的可靠性列为优先事项的常规压缩之外,人们越来越关注其他压缩目标。 在这项工作中,我们侧重于两种具有挑战性的情景:感知压缩[12,13,7,14]和机视压缩[15,16,17].
现有办法通过专门培训战略和建筑部分来实现这些目标。 例如,HiFiC [7]结合了对抗训练和感官优化,以产生视觉现实的重建. 适应-ICMH [17] 优化空间频率调制适配器,以压制与任务无关的冗余. 这些办法虽然对具体设想方案有效,但需要有针对具体目标的培训或可培训的额外组成部分。 相比之下,PICA是一个无培训框架,在推论时间对现有的黑盒编码器进行修改,而无需代码再优化或针对特定情景的模块重新设计. 通过全球对区域的质量控制,它根据概念或特定任务的优先次序分配比特。

blocks.en: II-B Quality-Aware Image Compression
blocks.zh: II-B 质量- 智能图像压缩

blocks.en: Most existing image compression methods treat the observed input as the reconstruction target, without explicitly accounting for acquisition degradations. In practice, however, images may contain noise, blur, or other degradations [ 19 , 21 , 22 , 24 , 25 ] . These degradations not only compromise visual quality but may also lead codecs to allocate additional bits to preserving undesirable signal variations rather than prioritizing the underlying clean signal [ 19 , 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 大多数现有的图像压缩方法将观测到的输入作为重建目标,而没有明确说明获取退化情况. 然而在实践中,图像可能包含噪音,模糊,或其他退化[19,21,22,24,25]. 这些降解不仅会损害视觉质量,而且可能导致解码器为保留不良信号变异而分配额外的位数,而不是优先处理基础的清洁信号[19,21].

blocks.en:
A common approach to addressing this issue is to jointly optimize compression and restoration [ 19 , 21 , 20 , 22 , 24 ] . For example, Cheng et al. [ 19 ] introduce a two-branch, weight-sharing architecture with feature denoisers for joint denoising and compression, while Wan et al. [ 24 ] explore joint compression and deblurring through blur-aware guidance. To avoid retraining the entire codec, Chen et al. [ 23 ] freeze a pre-trained codec and train additional latent refinement and prompt-generation modules for joint decoding and denoising. Overall, integrating restoration into these compression frameworks requires training either the full model or additional architectural components.
In contrast, PICA coordinates off-the-shelf restoration tools and black-box codecs without additional training. At inference time, it diagnoses input degradations and evaluates candidate restoration tools to select suitable operations. Before coding, it addresses input degradations by jointly considering bitrate and reconstruction quality. After decoding, it mitigates residual and compression-induced degradations.
blocks.zh:
解决这一问题的一个共同办法是共同优化压缩和恢复[19、21、20、22、24]。 以程等为例. [19]引入了两分支,权重共享的架构,其特征denoisers用于联合解码和压缩,而Wan et al. [24]探索联合压缩,通过模糊的知觉引导破解. 为避免整个解码器再培训,陈等人. [23] 冻结一个经过预先训练的编码器,并训练更多的潜在的改进和迅速生成模块,用于联合解码和解码. 总体而言,将恢复纳入这些压缩框架需要培训完整的模型或额外的建筑构件。
相比之下,PICA在没有额外训练的情况下协调现成的修复工具和黑盒解码器. 在推论时间,它诊断输入降解,评价候选恢复工具以选择合适的操作. 在编码前,它通过共同考虑比特率和重建质量来解决输入降解问题. 解码后,可以缓解残余和压缩引起的降解.

blocks.en: II-C Intelligent Agents for Image Processing
blocks.zh: II-C 图像处理智能代理

blocks.en: Intelligent agents are systems that autonomously perceive and act upon their environments to pursue specified goals [ 34 ] . Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled frameworks such as ReAct [ 35 ] , which interleaves reasoning and actions to guide decision-making through environmental feedback. Meanwhile, Vision–Language Models (VLMs) [ 36 , 37 , 38 ] provide visual understanding capabilities that support perception and assessment in image-processing agents. For example, You et al. . [ 39 ] introduce DepictQA, which analyzes image content and distortions to provide descriptive quality assessments beyond scalar scores.
blocks.zh: 智能代理是自主感知和对其环境采取行动以实现特定目标的系统[34]. " 大语言模型 " (LLMs)的近期进展使ReAct[35]等框架得以互通推理和行动,通过环境反馈指导决策。 同时,Vision–Langage Models(VLMs)[36,37,38]提供视觉理解能力,支持图像处理剂的感知和评估. 例如,You et al. . [39] 引入了DepictQA,它分析图像内容和扭曲,以提供描述性质量评估,超出标分.

blocks.en: Building on visual assessment and language-based reasoning, recent studies coordinate specialized restoration tools through agentic planning and execution [ 40 , 41 , 42 , 27 , 28 ] . Zhu et al. [ 27 ] propose AgenticIR to address complex image degradations through perception, scheduling, execution, reflection, and rescheduling. Zuo et al. [ 28 ] introduce 4KAgent for image restoration and 4K super-resolution, combining perception-guided planning with quality-driven tool selection and an iterative execution–reflection–rollback process. These works demonstrate the potential of integrating visual assessment, planning, and feedback to adaptively coordinate image restoration and enhancement tools.
blocks.zh: 在视觉评估和基于语言的推理的基础上,最近的研究通过代理规划和执行来协调专门恢复工具[40,41,42,27,28].  Zhu等. [27] 建议代理 IR通过感知,排程,执行,反射,以及重新安排时间来解决复杂的图像退化. 祖奥等. [28] 引入4Kagent用于图像修复和4K超解析,将感知引导规划与质量驱动工具选择和迭代执行-反演-回滚过程相结合. 这些作品显示了整合视觉评估、规划和反馈以适应性地协调图像恢复和增强工具的潜力。

blocks.en:
For image compression, Gao et al. [ 26 ] propose Comp-X, which integrates an LLM agent with a neural codec specifically designed and trained to work with the agent. Although Comp-X supports multiple compression objectives and ROI coding, these capabilities rely on trained task-specific adapters and internal codec mechanisms, including spatial quality maps and group masks.
Its agentic control therefore remains coupled to this specialized codec, leaving the adaptation of existing codecs without redesign or retraining ( i.e. , RQ1) unaddressed. In contrast, PICA adapts ready-to-use conventional and neural codecs as black boxes, enabling scenario-adaptive compression without codec-specific architectural modifications, task-specific adapters, or retraining. Moreover, Comp-X’s workflow does not explicitly consider or address acquisition degradations ( i.e. , RQ2), whereas PICA considers the effects of degradations on both rate and quality to guide restoration before encoding or after decoding.
blocks.zh:
用于图像压缩,Gao等人. [26] 提出Comp-X,将LLM剂与神经编码结合,专门设计并训练用于与剂合作. 尽管Comp-X支持多个压缩目标和ROI编码,但这些能力依赖于训练有素的任务特定适配器和内部编码机制,包括空间质量图和组口罩.
因此,它的代理控制仍然与这个专门的编码器结合,使得对现有编码器的修改没有经过重新设计或再培训(即RQ1)的问题得不到解决。 相比之下,PICA则将现成的常规和神经编码器作为黑匣子进行改造,使情景适应性压缩能够不进行特定编码的建筑改造,任务特定的适配器,或者再培训. 此外,Comp-QQ工作流程没有明确考虑或处理获取退化(即RQ2),而PICA则考虑降解对速率和质量的影响,以指导编码之前或解码之后的恢复。

Taking the observed image 𝐱 \mathbf{x} and configuration 𝒮 \mathcal{S} as inputs, the Improvement Agent updates 𝐱 \mathbf{x} through QR–aware restoration.
It encodes the image using the target codec 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and applies SGQR-based reflection to improve the QR trade-off in subsequent coding iterations.
The Coding Agent then encodes the updated image 𝐱 \mathbf{x} using an off-the-shelf black-box codec 𝒞 \mathcal{C} under the configuration 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , producing an aggregate coded representation ℬ \mathcal{B} and its decoded reconstruction 𝐱 ~ \widetilde{\mathbf{x}} .
It first performs a global QC search by initializing a codec-specific quality-control parameter and iteratively refining it based on the measured bitrate and reconstruction quality to meet the specified requirements.
To account for spatial variations in content importance under the target compression scenario ℐ \mathcal{I} , the Coding Agent further employs AROIC to preserve important regions while reducing the coding cost of less critical content.
Through SGQR-based plan reflection, AROIC enables region-adaptive compression for the objective, without codec-specific architectural modifications or retraining.
Finally, the After-Coding Improvement Agent updates the decoded reconstruction 𝐱 ~ \widetilde{\mathbf{x}} using a restoration procedure similar to the Improvement Agent, but evaluates restoration candidates using image quality alone.
The resulting pair ( ℬ , 𝐱 ~ ) (\mathcal{B},\widetilde{\mathbf{x}}) constitutes the final output of the agentic coding function ℱ \mathcal{F} in Eq. 3 .

In this work, we primarily consider three representative compression scenarios.
For standard compression , Q ℐ Q_{\mathcal{I}} is defined as the mean squared error between the reconstructed and reference images.
For perceptual compression , it quantifies perceptual dissimilarity between these images using DISTS and LPIPS.
For machine-vision compression , it is defined as the negative of a task-specific performance score evaluated on the reconstructed image ( e.g. , a weighted average of the product of detection confidence and IoU for object detection), with task predictions on the reference image serving as pseudo-ground truth.
The procedures for obtaining the bitrate b b , reconstructed image 𝐱 ^ \widehat{\mathbf{x}} , and reference image 𝐱 ref \mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{ref}} in the Improvement and Coding Agents are detailed in Secs. III-C and III-D , respectively.

blocks.en: We develop the Improvement Agent and After-Coding Improvement Agent to adaptively handle image degradations through restoration before encoding or after decoding for improved QR performance.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了改进代理和后编码改进代理,通过编码前或解码后修复来适应性地处理图像降解,以提高QR性能.

blocks.en:
Improvement Agent. Unlike previous restoration agents [ 27 , 28 ] that primarily aim to improve image quality, our agent performs pre-coding restoration to improve the QR trade-off of subsequent compression.
For example, denoising can substantially reduce the bits spent on unwanted noise, but excessive denoising may remove meaningful details and impair reconstruction quality.
Conversely, deblurring can improve image quality, but the recovered details may require additional bits to encode.
These competing effects motivate jointly considering reconstructed image quality and bitrate when deciding which restoration operations to apply.
Guided by the diagnosed degradations 𝒢 δ ′ ​ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{G}^{\prime}_{\delta}(\cdot) , the agent follows a scheduling–execution–reflection pipeline.
It first schedules restoration subtasks, such as denoising or deblurring.
For each subtask, it applies T − 1 T-1 candidate restoration tools to the subtask input and includes the unchanged input as a no-restoration baseline, producing T T uncompressed candidate images 𝐱 ( t ) t ∈ 𝒯 pre {\mathbf{x}^{(t)}}_{t\in\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{pre}}} , where 𝒯 pre = { 1 , … , T } \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{pre}}=\{1,\ldots,T\} .
It then evaluates the compression outcomes of these candidates and uses the resulting feedback to refine the remaining restoration plan.

As illustrated in Fig. 2 , the agent initializes a global QC parameter q g q_{g} based on the QR preference λ ℐ \lambda_{\mathcal{I}} , explicit compression requirements ( e.g. , target bitrate and compression ratio), and codec-specific QC knowledge ( e.g. , guidance on QP usage in H.266/VVC) provided in the configuration 𝒮 \mathcal{S} .
The codec then encodes and decodes 𝐱 \mathbf{x} using q g q_{g} , and the measured bitrate and reconstruction quality are checked against the specified rate requirements and quality thresholds.
If these requirements are satisfied, the current setting q g q_{g} is retained.
Otherwise, the agent generates feedback identifying the unmet requirements and updates q g ← q g next q_{g}\leftarrow q_{g}^{\mathrm{next}} accordingly, aiming to improve reconstruction quality when it is unacceptable or bring the bitrate closer to the target while maintaining acceptable quality.
This process continues until both the rate and quality requirements are satisfied or the iteration limit is reached.
The resulting global QC parameter q g q_{g} is used in the subsequent AROIC procedure.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四 试验

blocks.en: IV-A Datasets and Protocols.
blocks.zh: 数据集和协议。

blocks.en:
Datasets. We evaluate our methods on three datasets: Kodak, CLIC2020, and HEVC. Kodak [ 29 ] consists of 24 natural images and is a widely used benchmark for image compression. The CLIC2020 validation set [ 30 ] contains 102 high-resolution images spanning diverse scenes and textures, enabling evaluation on more varied visual content.
For machine-vision compression, we use images sampled from the HEVC test sequences [ 31 ] , with ground-truth object categories and bounding boxes provided by SFU-HW-Objects-v3 [ 73 , 74 ] . Specifically, we select 8 sequences from Classes C and D, divide each sequence into 6 equal temporal segments, and extract the 1 s ​ t 1^{st} frame from each segment, yielding 48 images.
blocks.zh:
数据集. 我们用三个数据集来评价我们的方法:Kodak、CLIC2020和HEVC。 Kodak [29] 由24幅自然图像组成,是广泛使用的图像压缩基准. CLIC2020验证集 [30] 包含102个高分辨率图像,覆盖了不同的场景和纹理,使得能够对更多不同的视觉内容进行评价.
在机视压缩方面,我们使用从HEVC测试序列中取样的图像[31],由SPU-HW-Objects-v3[73,74]提供地面真实对象类别和边框. 具体地说,我们从C级和D级中选择了8个序列,将每个序列分为6个等时间段,从每个区段中提取1s t 1^{st}帧,生成48个图像.

blocks.en: Degradation We consider two common image degradations that can substantially affect compression performance, which are noise and blur [ 19 , 21 , 20 , 24 ] . Following prior agentic image restoration methods [ 27 , 28 ] , we synthetically generate additive Gaussian noise and defocus blur from the original images. Specifically, we add Gaussian noise with a standard deviation of σ = 15 \sigma=15 in the 8-bit pixel intensity range. To generate defocus blur, we use a circular disk point-spread function with a radius of 3 pixels, smoothed with a 3 × 3 3\times 3 Gaussian filter, to blur each image. We apply each degradation independently to the images in the Kodak dataset, the CLIC2020 validation set, and the HEVC test set. The original images form the clean benchmarks. Thus, each dataset has 3 benchmarks: clean, Gaussian-noise, and defocus-blur. In total, there are 9 compression benchmarks: Kodak, Noisy Kodak, Blurred Kodak, CLIC2020, Noisy CLIC2020, Blurred CLIC2020, HEVC, Noisy HEVC, and Blurred HEVC.
blocks.zh: 退化 我们认为,有两种常见的图像退化会严重影响压缩性能,即噪音和模糊[19、21、20、24]。 按照先前的剂性图像修复方法[27,28],我们合成生成添加剂高斯噪音,并从原始图像中去焦化. 具体来说,我们在8位像素强度范围内加入高斯噪声,标准偏差为=15\sigma=15. 为了产生分焦模糊,我们使用一个圆盘点散射函数,半径为3像素,用3×3 3\times 3 Gaussian滤镜平滑,以模糊每个图像. 我们将每个降解分别应用到Kodak数据集,CLIC2020验证集,HEVC测试集中的图像上. 原始图像构成干净的基准. 因此,每个数据集都有3个基准:干净、高斯噪声和去焦耳。 共有9个压缩基准:柯达,诺伊西·柯达,布卢瑞德·柯达,CLIC2020,诺伊西·CLIC2020,布卢瑞德·CLIC2020,HEVC,诺伊西·HEVC,和布卢瑞德·HEVC.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. For the 6 clean, noise and blur benchmarks derived from the Kodak and CLIC2020 validation sets, we evaluate reconstruction fidelity using PSNR, the most widely used objective metric for image compression. We also report 3 perceptual metrics: LPIPS and DISTS, computed per image and averaged over each benchmark, and FID, computed at the domain level by comparing the distributions of reconstructed images and their clean references. Here, clean references denote the original ground-truth images without synthetic degradation. For machine-vision compression, we evaluate object detection performance using mAP [ 0.50 : 0.95 ] \mathrm{mAP}_{[0.50:0.95]} , following [ 75 ] . Faster R-CNN [ 66 ] with a ResNeXt-101-32x8d-FPN backbone is used as the downstream detector for all methods. All bitrates are reported in bits per pixel (Bpps), calculated by dividing the number of coded bits by the number of pixels in the corresponding image.
blocks.zh: 评价计量。 对于来自Kodak和CLIC2020验证集的6个清洁,噪音和模糊的基准,我们使用PSNR来评价重建忠心,这是图像压缩最广泛使用的客观度量. 我们还报告3个感知度量:LPIPS和DISTS,按图像计算,并按每个基准进行平均计算;FID,通过比较重建图像的分布及其干净的参考,在域一级计算。 这里,干净的参考表示原始的地面真实图像,而不合成退化. 对于机器-视觉压缩,我们使用mAP[0.50:0.95]\mathrm{mAP}_{[0.50:0.95]]评价物体检测性能,跟随[75]. 更快的R-CNN [66] 配有ResNEXt-101-32x8d-FPN主干线作为所有方法的下游探测器. 所有比特速率都以比特每像素(Bpps)进行报告,计算方法是将编码比特数除以相应图像中的像素数.

blocks.en: IV-B Baseline Codecs.
blocks.zh: 基线编码。

blocks.en: We evaluate our PICA using two representative codecs: the conventional H.266/VVC codec in intra-frame coding mode ( i.e. , VVC) [ 2 ] and the neural image codec Cheng2020 [ 32 ] . For VVC, we use the VTM-24.0 reference software [ 76 ] with encoder_intra_vtm.cfg and the reduced-runtime configuration. For Cheng2020, we use the Cheng2020Anchor variant implemented in CompressAI-1.2.8 [ 77 ] . For each codec, we assume only that the agent has high-level prior knowledge of how a single control parameter affects bitrate and reconstruction quality. That is the quantization parameter ( i.e. , QP) for VVC and the quality level ( i.e. , q q ) for Cheng2020. Our PICA is training-free and requires no knowledge of codec internals or additional codec-specific expertise
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个具有代表性的编码符来评价我们的PICA:常规H266/VVC编码符在帧内编码模式(即VVC)[2]和神经影像编码符成2020[32]. 对于VVC,我们使用VTM-24.0参考软件[76],并带有编码器_intra_vtm.cfg和减速运行时间配置. 对于成2020,我们使用在CompressAI-12.8中实施的成2020Anchor变体[77]. 对于每个编码器,我们仅假设该代理机对单个控制参数如何影响比特率和重建质量有高水平的事先知识. 这就是VVC的量化参数(即QP)和成2020的质量级(即qq). 我们的PICA是无培训的,不需要任何密码内部知识或额外的密码专用专门知识.

blocks.en: In addition to the two base codecs for standard image compression, we include three specialized codecs designed and optimized for specific compression scenarios: HiFiC [ 7 ] for perceptual compression, Adapt-ICMH [ 17 ] for machine-vision compression, and DenoiseCompression [ 19 ] for compression of noisy images. We use an open-source PyTorch reimplementation [ 78 ] of HiFiC and the official open-source implementations of Adapt-ICMH and DenoiseCompression.
blocks.zh: 除了标准图像压缩的2个基础解码器外,我们还包括3个为特定压缩方案设计和优化的专用解码器:用于感知压缩的HiFiC [7],用于机器-视觉压缩的Adapt-ICMH [17]和用于压缩噪音图像的DenoiseCompress [19]. 我们使用了HiFiC的开源PyTorch重新执行[78]以及Adapt-ICMH和DenoiseCompress的官方开源执行.

blocks.en: IV-C Experiment Results.
blocks.zh: IV-C实验结果.

blocks.en:
We evaluate compression performance across different compression scenarios and input conditions on Kodak, CLIC2020, and HEVC in Fig. 3 , Fig. 4 , and Fig. 5 , respectively.
In general, PICA consistently improves the QR performance of both baseline codecs across the evaluated scenarios and degradations, demonstrating its ability to adapt Cheng2020 and VVC to diverse compression objectives.
For example, in perceptual compression, PICA achieves average bitrate savings at matched LPIPS of 34.52%, 44.90%, and 62.66% over Cheng2020, and 28.96%, 43.17%, and 59.95% over VVC, on the clean, noisy, and blurred Kodak benchmarks.
For machine-vision compression on HEVC Class D, PICA achieves average relative gains in mAP [ 0.50 : 0.95 ] \mathrm{mAP}_{[0.50:0.95]} of 52.58%, 40.94%, and 55.77% over Cheng2020, and 62.28%, 80.46%, and 55.56% over VVC, under clean, noisy, and blurred input conditions, respectively, at matched bitrates.
Notably, even though both baseline codecs are specifically optimized for standard compression, PICA achieves further average bitrate savings at matched PSNR of 8.96%, 22.86%, and 31.07% over Cheng2020, and 7.49%, 22.99%, and 35.81% over VVC, on the clean, noisy, and blurred Kodak benchmarks.

总的来说,PICA在所评价的情景和退化中始终不断提高基准编码器的QR性能,表明其能够使Cheng2020和VVC适应不同的压缩目标.
例如,在感知压缩中,PICA实现了平均比特率的节省,与LPIPS相匹配的比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比
对于HEVC类D的机视压缩,PICA在mAP[0.50:0.95]\mathrm{mAP}[0.50:0.95]中分别以52.58%,40.94%,55.77%的比成2020,以及62.28%,80.46%,55.56%的比VVC,在匹配比特率下分别实现相对平均增量.
值得注意的是,尽管两个基线编码器都专门为了标准压缩进行了优化,但PICA在PSNR的匹配率下,进一步实现了平均比特率节约,比成2020年的8.96%、22.86%和31.07%,在干净、吵闹和模糊的柯达基准上达到7.49%、22.99%和35.81%。

blocks.en:
On the other hand, we observe that codecs optimized for specific compression objectives or input conditions often exhibit limited generalization across scenarios and degradations.
For instance, HiFiC achieves strong perceptual performance on clean images, but requires 185.89% and 111.57% more bitrate than PICA+VVC at matched PSNR for standard compression on clean Kodak and CLIC2020, respectively.
Its perceptual performance also deteriorates under input degradations.
On the degraded Kodak and CLIC2020 benchmarks, HiFiC exhibits substantially higher LPIPS scores than PICA+VVC at comparable bitrates, indicating much lower perceptual quality.
Similarly, DenoiseCompression, specifically optimized for standard compression of noisy images, exhibits limited robustness to blur.
Adapt-ICMH performs well in machine-vision compression on clean images but remains less competitive in standard and perceptual compression, with its machine-vision performance also falling behind PICA under degradations.
blocks.zh:
另一方面,我们观察到,为特定压缩目标或输入条件而优化的编码器往往在各种情景和退化中表现出有限的概括性。
例如,HiFiC在清洁图像上实现了强烈的感知性能,但分别需要185.89%和111.57%比PICA+VVC的比比PSNR更高的比分率来进行清洁柯达和CLIC2020的标准压缩.
其知觉性能在投入退化下也会恶化.
在退化的Kodak和CLIC2020基准上,HiFiC在可比比特率下显示的LPIPS分数比PICA+VVC高得多,表明知觉质量要低得多.
同样,DenoiseCompression(英语:DenoiseCompression),专门为了对吵闹的图像进行标准压缩而进行了优化,展现出有限的强性以模糊.
适应-ICMH在清洁图像上的机视压缩方面表现良好,但在标准和感知压缩方面仍然缺乏竞争力,其机视性能在退化下也落后于PICA.

Effectiveness of Individual Agents. We evaluate the effectiveness of the agents on the blurred Kodak benchmark by progressively incorporating them into Cheng2020 and VVC.
Specifically, we introduce two intermediate variants: the baseline codec equipped with the Perception and Improvement Agents ( i.e. , P & I), and a variant that additionally incorporates the After-coding Improvement Agent ( i.e. , P & I & A).
Fig. 6 (a) and (b) compare these variants with the baseline codecs and the full PICA framework.
These results demonstrate the complementary benefits of pre-coding restoration, post-coding restoration, and AROIC.
Our observation is that, by enabling QR-aware pre-coding restoration, the P & I variant reduces LPIPS by 6.87% and 13.94%, and DISTS by 15.83% and 27.15%, relative to Cheng2020 and VVC, respectively.
Adding the After-coding Improvement Agent for quality-only post-coding restoration further reduces LPIPS by 1.76% and 5.52%, and DISTS by 6.83% and 14.07%, relative to the corresponding P & I variants, which use pre-coding restoration only.
The full PICA framework achieves the best QR performance among the evaluated variants.
Compared with the restoration-only P & I & A variants, incorporating the Coding Agent with AROIC further reduces LPIPS by 7.62% and 11.56%, and DISTS by 10.05% and 22.66%, for Cheng2020 and VVC, respectively.
These results demonstrate the complementary benefits of pre-coding restoration, post-coding restoration, and AROIC.

Robustness Across VLM Agent Backbones. To evaluate PICA’s robustness to the choice of VLM agent backbone, we compare three VLMs: two open-source models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct [ 37 ] and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 38 ] , and one commercial model, GPT-6.1-Sol [ 79 ] .
Here, the VLM agent backbone refers to the model that supports user instruction interpretation, image analysis, task planning, tool invocation, and feedback-guided plan refinement across all agents.
Fig. 6 (c) presents the results on the noisy Kodak benchmark.
The three backbones yield nearly identical QR performance, suggesting that PICA’s effectiveness is robust to the choice of backbone among the evaluated VLMs.
These results support flexible deployment with different VLM backbones, allowing the choice to accommodate available computational resources and deployment requirements.

blocks.en: IV-E Qualitative Study

In addition to the quantitative evaluation, Fig. 7 presents qualitative comparisons using four samples each from the noisy and blurred Kodak benchmarks.
We compare Cheng2020 and VVC with their PICA-enhanced counterparts.
Across both degradations, PICA produces reconstructions with better visual quality and lower LPIPS scores while reducing bitrate.

For blurred images, blur substantially degrades fine details, as illustrated by the water surface textures in the sixth row and the rock textures in the eighth row.
The baseline codecs do not effectively restore these details, whereas PICA produces clearer and more discernible textures through deblurring.
Despite restoring texture details, PICA achieves lower LPIPS scores without increasing bitrate relative to the corresponding baselines.
These observations further support the effectiveness of our SGQR strategy in jointly considering bitrate and reconstruction quality when selecting restoration and coding plans, rather than pursuing restoration quality alone.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced PICA, a training-free multi-agent framework that adapts existing image codecs to diverse compression scenarios and potentially degraded inputs.
It combines four collaborative agents with SGQR evaluation and feedback-guided reflection to coordinate restoration and coding according to specific user requirements and potential input degradations.
Extensive experiments on the Kodak, CLIC2020, and HEVC datasets demonstrate that PICA improves the quality–rate performance of both the conventional codec H.266/VVC and the neural codec Cheng2020 across standard, perceptual, and machine-vision compression under clean, noisy, and blurred input conditions.
These improvements are achieved without codec-specific architectural modifications, retraining on large-scale datasets, or detailed knowledge of codec internals.
By decoupling scenario adaptation from extensive codec redevelopment and scenario-specific training, PICA enables advances in standard codecs to benefit a broader range of image processing and transmission applications.
More broadly, this work connects agentic decision-making with image compression research and motivates further exploration of VLM-based agents for compression and related visual processing tasks.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们提出了PICA,这是一个免费的多代理框架,它使现有的图像编码器适应不同的压缩情景和潜在的退化输入.
它与SGQR的评价和反馈引导反射结合了四个协作代理,根据具体的用户要求和潜在的输入退化来协调恢复和编码.
有关Kodak、CLIC2020和HEVC数据集的广泛实验表明,PICA提高了传统编码H.266/VVC和神经编码Cheng2020的质量-速率性能,在干净、吵闹和模糊的输入条件下跨越标准、感知和机器视觉压缩。
这些改进是在不进行具体编码的建筑改造,不进行大规模数据集的再培训,也不对编码内部进行详细了解的情况下实现的.
通过将情景适应与广泛的代码再开发和情景特定培训脱钩,PICA使标准代码的进步能够惠及更广泛的图像处理和传输应用.
更广泛地说,这项工作将代理决策与图像压缩研究联系起来,并激励进一步探索基于VLM的代理以完成压缩和相关视觉处理任务.
